Universal testing machine ZwickRoell ProLine Z010
Universal testing machine ZwickRoell ProLine Z010
Whether it’s a smartphone casing, a car bumper, or food packaging – plastics are part of almost every moment of our daily lives. But before a plastic product enters mass production, it must prove what it’s really made of. This is where universal testing machines come into play.
These testing devices examine how plastics respond to tensile, compressive, or bending loads. They provide precise data on how strong, flexible, or dimensionally stable a material is – properties that are crucial for safety, durability, and functionality.
Modern universal testing machines are high-tech systems featuring accurate force measurement, digital data acquisition, and adaptable test fixtures. They enable standardized testing according to norms such as DIN EN ISO 527 (tensile test) or DIN EN ISO 604 (compression test), ensuring comparable and reproducible results.
Materials that can be tested include:
Amorphous and semi-crystalline solid thermoplastics (e.g. polyethylene, polycarbonate)
Foams
Elastomers
Thermosets
Fiber-reinforced plastics (e.g. GFRP, CFRP, or aramid composites)
The ZwickRoell ProLine Z010 is a precise universal testing machine for standardized mechanical testing of materials and components with a maximum test force of 10 kN. It is specifically designed for routine applications in quality assurance, education, and materials development, offering reliable tensile, compression, bending, and shear tests for a wide range of materials – including plastics, metals, composites, and packaging.
Thanks to its dual-column design, the ProLine Z010 ensures high axial stiffness and precise alignment, enabling repeatable and accurate test results even under complex loading conditions.
Equipped with a maintenance-free AC motor and integrated testControl II electronics, the machine provides stable force and displacement control, even at very low test speeds.
